skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze cultural differences in international business environments and develop strategies to manage them.
Evaluate and apply strategies for international business management.
Make informed decisions in international management scenarios.
Understand and apply leadership theories in multicultural settings.
Effectively communicate and negotiate in multicultural environments.
Understand and apply ethical and social responsibility principles in international business.
Analyze and manage organizational culture in multinational companies.
Manage international human resources and develop training programs.
Understand the impact of globalization on international management.
Work independently and adapt to multicultural environments.
